name: Workshop first, then the shops
tag: Draw at 13:00, shop until 18:30. The school's pick for families
why: Start with the two hour manga workshop while everyone is fresh, then the shopping is the reward. The day ends at the station side, close to the trains for your dinner reservation.
steps: MANGA DOJO Tokyo workshop
Two hours of drawing manga with a working manga artist, English interpretation included. Nicholas draws his own character and takes the pages home.
Walk to Sunshine City
About 8 minutes on foot along Sunshine 60 Street.
Mugiwara Store and Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo
Sunshine City, Alpa 2F. The official One Piece store and Japan's largest Pokémon Center are on the same floor. Open to 20:00 on Sunday.
Gashapon Department Store and the One Piece Card Game shop
World Import Mart 3F, same building. Over 3,000 capsule toy machines, then Bandai Namco Cross Store with the official One Piece Card Game shop and Tamashii Nations figures. Open to 21:00.
BOOKOFF Sunshine 60 Street
Two floors of second hand manga, figures, anime goods and Pokémon cards. One Piece volumes in Japanese are everywhere. Open to 22:00.
Animate Ikebukuro flagship
Nine floors, one of the biggest anime shops in Japan. New manga, figures and limited goods across every series. Open to 21:00.
JUMP SHOP Ikebukuro PARCO
B2F of PARCO, right at the East Exit. The official Weekly Shonen Jump store: One Piece next to Naruto and Dragon Ball, with items sold nowhere else. Open to 21:00.
Done
Ikebukuro Station East Exit. Dinner at 20:30 is yours.
moves: Everything is on foot. Workshop → Sunshine City about 8 min. Sunshine City → Animate about 5 min. Animate → PARCO about 5 min.
good: A family that wants the hands-on part done first and a relaxed shopping run after.
mind: The 13:00 class is open on December 20 and is the one the school recommends for families. Shopping bags get heavy by the end, so the last two stops are short. Most stores have a tax free counter, so keep your passports with you.
bars: Gashapon Department Store and Cross Store

name: Shops first, then the workshop
tag: Shop from 13:00, draw at 15:15. The school's advanced class
why: Shopping near the station first, the workshop in the middle, and Sunshine City at the end. The 15:15 session is the school's advanced class, aimed at people who already draw, so the school suggests the 13:00 class for a family. It is still open if you prefer the afternoon.
steps: Meet at Ikebukuro Station East Exit
Then straight down to JUMP SHOP in PARCO B2F.
JUMP SHOP Ikebukuro PARCO
B2F of PARCO, right at the East Exit. The official Weekly Shonen Jump store: One Piece next to Naruto and Dragon Ball, with items sold nowhere else. Open to 21:00.
Animate Ikebukuro flagship
Nine floors, one of the biggest anime shops in Japan. New manga, figures and limited goods across every series. Open to 21:00.
BOOKOFF Sunshine 60 Street
Two floors of second hand manga, figures, anime goods and Pokémon cards. One Piece volumes in Japanese are everywhere. Open to 22:00.
Walk to the workshop
About 5 minutes. Classes start exactly on time.
MANGA DOJO Tokyo workshop, advanced class
Two hours with a working manga artist, English interpretation included. This session goes deeper into panel layout, anatomy and expressions, and ends with career questions for the artist.
Mugiwara Store and Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo
Sunshine City, Alpa 2F. The official One Piece store and Japan's largest Pokémon Center are on the same floor. Open to 20:00 on Sunday.
Gashapon Department Store and the One Piece Card Game shop
World Import Mart 3F, same building. A short run through 3,000 capsule toy machines and the official One Piece Card Game shop. Open to 21:00.
Done
Sunshine City. About 8 minutes back to the station on foot.
moves: Everything is on foot. Station → PARCO is inside the building. PARCO → Animate about 5 min. Animate → workshop about 5 min. Workshop → Sunshine City about 8 min.
good: A family that would rather warm up with the shops and keep the workshop as the main event.
mind: The 15:15 session is the school's advanced class and the school suggests 13:00 for families. The day ends at Sunshine City, 8 minutes from the station. Most stores have a tax free counter, so keep your passports with you.
